This ability can only be used when it has its shield. }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Your feeble acts are all for nothing!|audio = Night4Wave15.ogg|[[The Umbra (Narrator)|The Umbra]] dialogue on Wave 15 ([[Totality Tower]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Lunar Shield''' was an [[enemy]] that appeared on the fourth night of the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]. It had a large amount of health and a slightly slow speed, allowing enemies behind it to get further in the map. While it had its shield health, it would wield its shield, which let it occasionally increase its speed significantly. It would not be able to do so after losing all of its shield health, at which point its shield would break. Additionally, it had an extremely high amount of defense when it had its shield health. ==Appearance== The '''Lunar Shield''' had purple glowing skin. It had dark purple armor, a black arm-band on both of its arms and a lock around its head. It had a cracked torso, revealing a white substance within it. It held a shield in front, which was purple on the sides, grey and neon purple on the inside and had lunar symbols on it. ==Strategy== *You should get rid of its shield health as quickly as possible, as it gives the '''Lunar Shield''' very high defense and the ability to increase its speed significantly, which makes it soak up a lot of damage while moving forward at a fast pace. *High damage towers such as the [[Accelerator]], [[Minigunner]], [[Ranger]] and [[Turret]] should be used to take care of this enemy. **You should use the [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] to boost these towers. *Since it can move quite fast when using its ''Lunar Charge'' ability, slowing towers like the [[Toxic Gunner]], [[Sledger]] or [[Electroshocker]] are recommended to slow it down. **The [[Electroshocker]] can also be used to reduce the defense of this enemy. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Night Four - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Lunar Shield''' on a promotional video. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Lunar Shield''' bears a similar appearance to the [[Lunar Shard]], particularly with the cracked torso. ==Update History== *'''13 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]]g **'''Lunar Shield''' added. *'''26 January 2022''' - [[v1.0.1]] **'''Lunar Shield''' removed. {{TotalityTower|[[Cursed Horse]], [[Flare]] & [[Cursed Guard]]|Wave 14|Lunar Shield, [[Lunar Servant]] & [[Solar Servant]]|Wave 15|[[The Umbra]]|Wave 16}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
